scope: Source notes for accounts-records and later payments-digital authoring; this is not a publication or regional-review approval.
authoring_policy: Illustrative account balances, fees and holds are explicitly fictional. No current statutory coverage amount, refund deadline, account-opening entitlement or guaranteed recovery is taught. Verify the actual institution, product, jurisdiction and terms.

sources.supports: BankFind identifies current and former FDIC-insured banking institutions. Its scope is not every possible financial provider.
A nonbank app's relationship with a bank does not by itself establish the user's coverage; relevant pass-through conditions and the actual bank must be checked.
Use CONDUSEF's official SIPRES entry point to check the named financial institution.
Impersonators can copy a real institution's identity; verifying that the institution exists is not enough to authenticate a message or contact.
IPAB coverage has defined eligible obligations, limits and exclusions. The lesson directs verification rather than teaching a universal guarantee.
Banco Central provides an institution lookup with authorized, regulated or supervised entities and permitted operations.
FGC coverage is product- and condition-specific; its own coverage rules must be checked separately from the provider's authorization.

Promptly contact the actual bank or card provider about a suspected unauthorized charge and follow applicable statement or error-resolution instructions. No universal deadline is copied into the course.
Retain the claim acknowledgement and case reference when reporting an unfamiliar charge. The course does not promise the page's general refund timing in every scenario.
Compare the merchant's legal name on receipts before assuming that an unfamiliar statement description identifies an unauthorized charge.
Do not disclose account passwords to other people or rely on strangers for sensitive account operations.
Impersonation can seek login details or confirmation codes. Preserving evidence is useful; the lesson must not imply that assembling documentation is a prerequisite to reporting a suspected error.
